# Helen's Place

> Helen's Place is the practice of Dr Helen Ross, an internationally recognised
> dyslexia and dyscalculia specialist, diagnostic assessor and published
> researcher based in Trowbridge, Wiltshire, United Kingdom. She works with
> families, schools and organisations across the UK and internationally.
> Diagnostic assessments are always carried out in person, in Trowbridge.
> Tutoring and family support are also available online.

Dr Helen Ross is dyslexic and has ADHD herself. She holds a PhD from the
University of Bath, AMBDA (Associate Member of the British Dyslexia Association,
20/AMB04046), AMBDA Dyscalculia (23/AMD05008) and a current Assessment
Practising Certificate (23/APC05078), which means her diagnostic reports are
accepted by schools, by exam boards and for Disabled Students' Allowance. She is
Chair of the Wiltshire Dyslexia Association and a former Trustee of the British
Dyslexia Association.

Assessing dyscalculia needs a separate specialist qualification, which many
dyslexia assessors do not hold. Dr Ross holds it, and taught mathematics in
schools before training as an assessor. She does not charge separately for
dyslexia and dyscalculia: one diagnostic assessment explores both where needed,
for one fee.

She assesses children, teenagers and adults, including students applying for
Disabled Students' Allowance.

She has more than 13 peer-reviewed publications, contributed a review to the
Council for Science and Technology, gave evidence to an All-Party Parliamentary
Group at the House of Commons, and is the author of *Literacy Learning Journeys:
An Educator's Guide to Dyslexia, Ages 0-18* (Speechmark by Routledge, 2025,
ISBN 9781032659046).

She is a Churchill Fellow (2025, supported by The Mercers' Company). Her
Fellowship report, School & Beyond: Supporting Dyslexic & Neurodivergent Girls'
Next Moves, was published on 11 August 2026 following fieldwork in Australia and
the United States, and makes 30 recommendations for policymakers, institutions
and practitioners.

Contact: helen@helensplace.co.uk, 07541 557827. She replies within 48 hours and
offers a free 20-minute initial call.

## Services and prices

All prices include VAT.

- Full diagnostic assessment for dyslexia and dyscalculia, [price: Full diagnostic assessment] including VAT, with [price: Booking deposit] to secure the booking. The price covers both, explored in one assessment where needed, the full written report within two weeks, and a follow-up conversation about the findings. A sample report is available on request
- Diagnostic assessment for Disabled Students' Allowance, [price: Full diagnostic assessment]
- Exam access arrangements assessment, [price: Exam access arrangements]
- Other assessments, price on consultation
- Family support and advice, [price: Family support and advice], online or in person, including help with the EHCP process. Dr Ross also writes expert witness reports in EHCP and tribunal cases
- Literacy, dyslexia or mathematics tuition for KS2 to KS4, [price: Tuition], online
- Half-day INSET and CPD for schools, [price: Half-day INSET]
- Research and consultancy projects, [price: Research and consultancy]
- SEND expert witness reports, including EHCP and tribunal contexts, on enquiry

## Pages

- [Home](https://helensplace.co.uk/): overview of the three audiences served, families, schools, and business and legal
- [Articles](https://helensplace.co.uk/articles): twenty in-depth articles grouped by theme, covering what dyslexia is, assessment, mental health and wellbeing, family experience, teacher training, assistive technology and EdTech evidence, and young people's own voice. Each cites Dr Ross's published research with DOIs
- [Why I assess in person](https://helensplace.co.uk/articles/why-i-assess-in-person): why there are no online diagnostic assessments, why only one young person is assessed a day, and why the wait is usually about three months
- [The Schools Guide to Dyslexia](https://helensplace.co.uk/dyslexia-toolkit): a free, evidence-informed technology toolkit for teachers co-authored by Helen, covering phonological awareness, verbal memory, verbal processing, spelling, reading and writing
- [Courses and guides](https://helensplace.co.uk/courses): the Supporting SEND in Mainstream Classrooms course, plus free practical guides on reading, writing, spelling, working memory, task initiation, the gap between spoken and written work, and leaving school when neurodivergent
- [Dyslexia and dyscalculia assessments](https://helensplace.co.uk/assessments): private diagnostic assessments in person in Trowbridge, Wiltshire, with prices. One young person assessed a day, and the diary usually runs about three months ahead
- [Dyscalculia assessment](https://helensplace.co.uk/assessments/dyscalculia): what dyscalculia is, how it differs from maths anxiety, and why it is assessed alongside dyslexia for one fee, by an assessor who holds the specialist dyscalculia qualification and taught maths
- [Exam access arrangements](https://helensplace.co.uk/assessments/exam-access-arrangements): assessments for extra time and other exam arrangements at GCSE and A level, and why the school must agree to the assessor first
- [Assessments for Disabled Students' Allowance](https://helensplace.co.uk/assessments/students-and-dsa): diagnostic assessments for students heading to or already at university, and how a DSA application works
- [What happens in a dyslexia assessment](https://helensplace.co.uk/what-to-expect): the full process from booking to report, how long it takes, what tests are used, and how long the report stays valid
- [Schools and training](https://helensplace.co.uk/schools): INSET and CPD on dyslexia, dyscalculia and ADHD for schools and local authorities
- [Research and expert witness](https://helensplace.co.uk/research-and-expert-witness): qualitative research, consultancy and SEND expert witness work
- [The Elevator Series](https://helensplace.co.uk/elevator-series): fourteen short videos covering the whole dyslexia journey, each with a full transcript
- [Questions and answers](https://helensplace.co.uk/faq): the most common questions on assessments, costs, tutoring and the process
- [About Dr Helen Ross](https://helensplace.co.uk/about): background, credentials and qualifications
- [Churchill Fellowship](https://helensplace.co.uk/churchill-fellowship): her 2025 Churchill Fellowship, School and Beyond, on supporting dyslexic and neurodivergent girls aged 16 to 25 through the move beyond school, with fieldwork in Australia and the USA
- [Podcasts and interviews](https://helensplace.co.uk/podcasts-and-interviews): Helen's appearances on The SENDcast, Dyslexia Explored, re:think dyslexia, SucceedWithDyslexia, Our Dyslexic Connection and Practice As Research
- [Publications and media](https://helensplace.co.uk/publications): the full list of peer-reviewed and invited publications with DOIs
- [Literacy Learning Journeys](https://helensplace.co.uk/book): the book, published by Routledge
- [Speaking](https://helensplace.co.uk/speaking): keynotes and sessions on dyslexia, SEND and inclusion
- [Contact](https://helensplace.co.uk/contact): enquiry form and contact details
